trust_decision.summary: Whether a request may make Jenkins call AWS with a stored credential against a caller-chosen region/endpoint, or schedule an agent's EC2 instance for termination, is decided in the cloud descriptors' Stapler web methods (needs POST + Jenkins.ADMINISTER) and in EC2FleetNodeComputer.doDoDelete (needs POST + Computer.DELETE); at the pinned commit the descriptor methods check neither and doDoDelete checks only DELETE, without POST.

landing_point.why: EC2FleetCloud.DescriptorImpl.doTestConnection is the obvious 'Test Connection' form endpoint in the main cloud class: it builds an AWS client from the request's credential id, region and endpoint, with no POST or permission check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admins must still be able to test and fill with real AWS endpoints: blank endpoint (region-derived), China *.amazonaws.com.cn, mixed-case or space-padded URLs, scheme-less hosts, and gov/iso region names. Agent deletion must keep working for users with Computer.DELETE who are not admins. An over-broad fix (allow-listing only ec2.<region>.amazonaws.com, rejecting a blank endpoint, or requiring ADMINISTER on doDoDelete) breaks these.
